title: One lister of a commit's workflow runs, shared by ci-state and the attach
body:
Two readers make the same `gh run list --commit <sha>` call over different workflows: ci-state's `cistate_runs` (lib/cmd/ci-state), over release.ci.workflow, and, from ST0011 WP07, `release_read_assets_run` (lib/release.steps), over release.assets.workflow. Each lists a commit's runs with its own field list, its own limit handling and its own error words.

Fix: one lister in lib/release.steps, `<repo> <workflow> <sha> <limit>` to rows with the fields both need (databaseId, headSha, headBranch, status, conclusion, createdAt), its failure and limit refusal worded once. ci-state and the attach each keep their own pick over the rows.

Ruled for after the 0.1.19 release, low (vc, 2026-11-01, on WP07's design note): it consolidates landed code (ci-state, WP03) and is not on the release's path.

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 04:42Z by date -u): fixed at 63b50c0b68b11c27d8fe5d786bdb2677c2315a18, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh as the third of group A's train 1 (0308, 0309, 0312), its paths equal to the tested stack commit's, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. release_runs_list <repo> <workflow> <sha> <limit>, in lib/release.steps, is now the one lister of a commit's runs of one workflow: id, head sha, head branch, status, created and conclusion a row, asked for RELEASE_RUNS_LIMIT runs, its failed list and its limit refusal each worded once, and gh's words read from a file, never among the rows. ci-state's verdict and the attach's pick each keep their own pick over its rows, and cistate_runs is gone. Two answers change: ci-state's failed-list detail now names the workflow and the full sha, as the attach's always did, and anything gh writes on stderr as it succeeds no longer joins the attach's rows. A new releaseattach.bats arm reads the lister's rows, its limit refusal and a failing gh's words folded onto one line, and ci-state.bats's failed-list arm takes the one wording. Train 1's run on pplr-vc's desk, at e7133d13 in slot 01M6M084QB56E66T6M067SEX8A on 2026-11-04, was stopped at hv's word before its GNU legs ended, and the unit lands on its record under hv's rule of 2026-11-05. Both arms were red at their red clone, 0309's tip with the unit's two test files: releaseattach.bats's on the lister's absence, and ci-state.bats's on its own property, the old wording. At the tip under BSD, releasecore, releasecut, releaseattach, releasepublish, formula, ci-state, releaselegs, releasestatus, releasesnapshot and contract were green, and release.bats read 73 of 74, its one red at :480 the base's stale views, which main regenerated at 1c291303. Of the 21 GNU legs, 19 had ended, each green but that same red. The GNU legs, the tree scans, the whole suite and one critic pass run once, after every issue is closed. critic-shell reviewed the unit once before the run, and every finding was settled.
